Oh, merciful Virgin!”", "sha256": "1ee87d922c6b38b47d9a768b9f225934a59f048eddaef7759712a3c6f4d263d3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[138]", "source_html": "

“Thank God! Oh, merciful Virgin!”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u004-r0017", "tag": "p", "text": "In imitation, such having been her will of him, and such seeming to be the cue of the game, he smilingly pressed his own hand to his heart, although he called neither on God nor the Virgin.", "sha256": "adea2d106754b46c7e0f07faae47bd7307b880acd5fd7ee6ec43214d28aef152", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[139]", "source_html": "

In imitation, such having been her will of him, and such seeming to be the cue of the game, he smilingly pressed his own hand to his heart, although he called neither on God nor the Virgin.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u004-r0018", "tag": "p", "text": "“Won’t you ever be serious?” she flashed at him, noting his action.", "sha256": "f4203f1d3fbd686e8cd507abb2f04e52741282229dd56da8cd5bbc9de9429cfd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[140]", "source_html": "

“Won’t you ever be serious?” she flashed at him, noting his action.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u004-r0019", "tag": "p", "text": "And Francis was immediately and profoundly, as well as naturally, serious.", "sha256": "a9427c6a90ed08be9cae116969118adb1db600a47fc4687ecbc1ec77f5940ae7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[141]", "source_html": "

And Francis was immediately and profoundly, as well as naturally, serious.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u004-r0020", "tag": "p", "text": "“My dear lady...” he began.", "sha256": "a18f1caf15777ef693888c8b39001d630b0619376e34bdca7522eae19e0f3359", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[142]", "source_html": "

“My dear lady...” he began.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u004-r0021", "tag": "p", "text": "But an abrupt gesture checked him; and, with growing wonder, he watched her bend and listen, and heard the movement of bodies padding down some runway several yards away.", "sha256": "0d63ee3d3a1252654b051a6240fb5e69ba7e72da338f015cfc4cff1c903970b8", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[143]", "source_html": "

But an abrupt gesture checked him; and, with growing wonder, he watched her bend and listen, and heard the movement of bodies padding down some runway several yards away.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u004-r0022", "tag": "p", "text": "With a soft warm palm pressed commandingly to his to be silent, she left him with the abruptness that he had already come to consider as customary with her, and slipped away down the runway. Almost he whistled with astonishment. He might have whistled it, had he not heard her voice, not distant, in Spanish, sharply interrogate men whose Spanish voices, half-humbly, half-insistently and half-rebelliously, answered her.", "sha256": "7d25fb382ffa9fffcee7f79f3432fbbccdc8d463dd19a54c8a897bd2e55e1216", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[144]", "source_html": "

With a soft warm palm pressed commandingly to his to be silent, she left him with the abruptness that he had already come to consider as customary with her, and slipped away down the runway. ", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u004-r0023", "tag": "p", "text": "He heard them move on, still talking, and, after five minutes of dead silence, heard her call for him peremptorily to come out.", "sha256": "b073eacf20e614018adaaf49cd5e5a40306d47347255f85ac8f51ac6b08355bf", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[145]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u004-r0024", "tag": "p", "text": "“Gee! I wonder what Regan would do under such circumstances!” he smiled to himself as he obeyed.", "sha256": "49401f1967ef7dbae5f2ff9471c7c012e2f4b909e705db163f1b762d729defc9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[146]", "source_html": "

He followed her, no longer hand in hand, through the jungle to the beach. When she paused, he came beside her and faced her, still under the impress of the fantasy which possessed him that it was a game.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u004-r0027", "tag": "p", "text": "The anger of her blazing dark eyes scorched him.", "sha256": "b5cf9acc809ccf35c0e9de1826545f26b89e66e67e9e9c5d16fd00f5c32184da", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[149]", "source_html": "

The anger of her blazing dark eyes scorched him.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u004-r0028", "tag": "p", "text": "“You fool!” she cried, lifting her finger with what he considered undue intimacy to his toothbrush moustache. “As if that could disguise you!”", "sha256": "f5d05d235c29c1a8021ec4c2d8e738f8e0dd63cc98e85fc321c3528d13564ad9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[150]", "source_html": "
